# Aesthetics by Michelle

Licensed skincare and aesthetics services in Post Falls, Idaho.
Owner-operator: Michelle Hoffman, Licensed Idaho Esthetician (EST-292960).

## About

Aesthetics by Michelle is a solo-practitioner skincare studio in Post Falls, Idaho,
serving the greater Coeur d'Alene and Spokane Valley area. Michelle has over 15 years
of experience in the skincare and aesthetics industry and holds an Idaho Esthetician
license (EST-292960) issued by the Idaho Barber and Cosmetology Services Licensing Board.

## Services

- Microneedling
- Facials
- Dermaplaning
- Brow Lamination, Eyelash Lift & Tint, Brow Shaping
- Facial, Eyebrow, and Underarm Waxing
